circles.name: Delhi
notes: The Delhi LSA also serves NCR towns in Haryana (Gurugram, Faridabad) and Uttar Pradesh (Noida, Ghaziabad). Google Trends reports those under Haryana / Uttar Pradesh, so they are not counted here.

circles.name: Gujarat
circles.jurisdiction: Gujarat, Daman and Diu, Dadra & Nagar Haveli

circles.name: Haryana
notes: Gurugram and Faridabad are in the Delhi LSA and Panchkula in the Punjab LSA; Google Trends' Haryana figure includes them.

circles.name: Jammu & Kashmir
notes: Google Trends has no separate Ladakh region; Ladakh searches sit inside Jammu and Kashmir.

circles.name: Kolkata
notes: Metro LSA inside West Bengal. Google Trends has no Kolkata-only region, so the West Bengal figure is shown for both the Kolkata and West Bengal circles.

circles.name: Maharashtra
notes: Mumbai is a separate metro LSA inside Maharashtra; the Maharashtra figure covers both circles.

circles.name: Mumbai
notes: Metro LSA inside Maharashtra. Google Trends has no Mumbai-only region, so the Maharashtra figure is shown for both the Mumbai and Maharashtra circles.

circles.name: North East
circles.jurisdiction: Meghalaya, Tripura, Manipur, Mizoram, Nagaland, Arunachal Pradesh

circles.name: Punjab
notes: Panchkula (Haryana) is also served by the Punjab LSA; Google Trends counts it under Haryana.

circles.name: Tamil Nadu
notes: Puducherry's Mahe (inside Kerala) and Yanam (inside Andhra Pradesh) enclaves are part of the UT; the DGT table lists Puducherry under Tamil Nadu without a district split.

circles.name: Uttar Pradesh (East)
notes: Uttar Pradesh is split East / West by district. Google Trends reports one Uttar Pradesh figure, so it is shown for both UP circles (it cannot be split).

circles.name: Uttar Pradesh (West)
notes: Uttar Pradesh is split East / West by district (and Noida / Ghaziabad are in the Delhi LSA). The single Uttar Pradesh figure is shown for both UP circles.

circles.name: West Bengal
notes: Kolkata is a separate metro LSA inside West Bengal; the West Bengal figure covers both circles.

circle_source.note: DoT / Director General Telecom — List of LSAs and their jurisdiction (page updated 25 Sep 2026)
